summary: Plan to improve the Cosma config.yml for the Ecosistema Fintech Global project. Changes include: adding record_types mapped to the actual category subdirectories (Paytech, Neobancos, Insurtech, etc.), improving graph physics for large graphs, adding record_metas to expose existing YAML fields (Company, Country, Vertical, Status), enabling hide_id_from_record_header, adding a link_symbol, and running cosma modelize to regenerate the cosmoscope for visual verification.
